en: A colored vintage postcard depicting a waterfront scene of Port Said with sailing boats and a tall lighthouse-like tower on the right. Inset at the left is an illustration of two men in traditional Middle Eastern clothing conversing under an archway, and above them a small round vignette of a veiled woman. The upper border is decorated with blossoming branches and fruit. French caption text appears below the main image.
